title: Hacker House Medellín (Leptos SSR)
description: The Leptos server-rendered front end. It holds no state and calls no database: three routes, two of which render or upgrade rather than return JSON, so they carry `client: false`.

Health.doc: Built inline with serde_json::json!, so the field names below are the whole contract.

ui.doc: Constant `leptos-ssr` -- identifies which front end answered.

healthz.summary: Liveness, plus which front end answered.

realtime.summary: Websocket upgrade. The server greets the client with a plain-text banner and echoes `ack:<text>` for every text frame; no JSON is exchanged.
